generated_cases.title: Print Page with Frames on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that a web page containing frames prints properly on Seamonkey, ensuring all frame contents render correctly in the printed output.

generated_cases.title: Print Page with Various Formats on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that pages incorporating various formatting elements print successfully without layout corruption or missing content.

generated_cases.title: Print Aligned Text on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that text alignments (left, right, center, justified) on a page print exactly as they appear on the screen.

generated_cases.title: Print Indented Text on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that single and nested text indentations print accurately as seen on the screen.

generated_cases.title: Print with Portrait and Landscape Settings on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that pages print properly when switching between portrait and landscape orientation settings.

generated_cases.title: Print HTML Widgets on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that HTML widgets such as buttons, input fields, and dropdowns print correctly.

generated_cases.title: Print Page Source on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that raw page source views print accurately as seen on the screen.

generated_cases.title: Print CSS Pages on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that pages styled with external, internal, and inline CSS sheets print properly.

generated_cases.title: Print Mozillazine Poll Results Page on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that the specific Mozillazine Poll results page prints correctly without formatting errors.

generated_cases.title: Print Large Pages on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that large pages with multi-page splitting requirements print properly without performance or memory issues.

generated_cases.title: Print XML Pages on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that XML documents, including raw XML and XML with XSLT, print properly.

generated_cases.title: Print Top Web Sites on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that popular top web sites print properly and maintain structural integrity.

generated_cases.title: Print HTML 4.0 Pages on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that HTML 4.0 compliant pages print properly across strict and transitional DTDs.

generated_cases.title: Print Images Correctly on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that images in various formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF) print correctly and missing image links are handled appropriately.

generated_cases.title: Print Lists Correctly on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that ordered, unordered, and nested lists print correctly with proper bulleting and numbering.

generated_cases.title: Print Tables Correctly on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that tables, including multi-page tables, cell padding, and borders, print correctly.

generated_cases.title: Print Character Styles Correctly on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that character styles such as bold, italic, underline, and custom fonts print accurately.

generated_cases.title: Print Paragraph Styles Correctly on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that paragraph styles including line spacing and margins print accurately.

generated_cases.title: Print Preview Functionality on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that Print Preview functions correctly and matches the final printed output.

generated_cases.title: Page Setup Dialog Display on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that the Page Setup dialog displays correctly with fully responsive controls and proper layout rendering.

generated_cases.title: Off-line Printing on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that off-line printing functions correctly without network connectivity and handles missing remote resources gracefully.

generated_cases.title: Print Header and Footer Info on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that header and footer information, including custom variables like date, title, URL, and page numbers, gets printed properly.

generated_cases.title: Print Files with Page Ranges on Seamonkey
generated_cases.description: Verify that files print successfully using a range of page numbers (e.g., single pages, comma-separated lists, and page ranges), and handle invalid ranges correctly.

reference_cases.title: TC-109
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch Apprunner
2. Click here to view a page with horizontal frames
3. Click here to view a page with vertical frames.
4. Once each page loads, select menu option "FILE| PRINT"
5. Press "OK" on Print Dialog Box to print the page.

EXPECTED RESULTS
After Step 5, the page should be printed as seen on screen

reference_cases.title: TC-113
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch Apprunner
2. Click here to view a sample page
3. Select menu option "FILE| PRINT"
4. Click on the "Properties" button.
5. Under the "Page Setup" option, in the frame titled "Orientation", select the radio button titled "Portrait"
6. Press OK twice to print the page
7. Repeat step 1 thru 3 and select the radio button titled "Landscape" under the "Orientation" Frame.
8. Press "OK" twice to print the page

EXPECTED RESULTS
After Step 6, the page should be printed in Portrait setting
After Step 8, the page should be printed in Landscape setting

reference_cases.description:

reference_cases.title: TC-119
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION

2. Click here to open a XML Test suite.
3. Open each test page and print the page.
4. Click here to open a listing of .xml and .css pages.
5. Select any of the xml files to view them.
6. Select the menu option "FILE | PRINT" to print the xml page
7. Press "OK" to print the page
8. Try printing other xml pages from the listing

EXPECTED RESULTS
XML pages should print as they appear on screen.

reference_cases.title: TC-127
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Browse test page
2. Select "FILE | PRINT" Preview menu option
3. Click on Next Page and make sure it goes to next page
4. Click on Zoom In to zoom into page
5. Click on Zoom Out to zoom out of page
6. Click on Previous Page and make sure it goes back
7. Click on Close and make sure it closes preview window

EXPECTED RESULTS
Print Preview functions should work properly.

reference_cases.title: TC-129
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
You should have a local printer connected to your machine to test this

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Go to Windows Build Prerequisites
3. Select "File | Work Offline"
4. Select "File | Print"

EXPECTED RESULTS
All pages should get printed even when you are offline

reference_cases.title: TC-130
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Go to Windows Build Prerequisites
3. Select "File| Print"
4. The printed pages should have the webpage name and the url on top left/right
5. The bottom of the printed pages should show the number of pages printed and date/time (system)

EXPECTED RESULTS
Header/Footer info should print correctly

reference_cases.title: TC-131
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Go to Windows Build Prerequisites
3. Do "File | Print"
4. Once the "Print" dialog comes up, click on the radio button titled "Pages"
5. Enter a value for the number of pages to print (say 1 to 3)

EXPECTED RESULTS:
Only pages 1 to 3 should get printed
